text_block_list.text:
During training, Tanino Gimlet suffered an 
injury, so I hurriedly brought her to the 
nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... The gods seem eager to test me. 
They appear hell-bent on keeping me far 
away from glory.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, I am not one to be broken here. 
Stagnation has no place in my script."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If hellfire seeks to consume me, then I 
shall blaze even brighter, and transmute 
it all into radiance!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is in the depths of adversity that I am 
honed to perfection! Now, let us etch my 
existence into history!!
choice_data_list:
I just really want you to rest quietly for 
now.

As long as you don't push yourself too 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
……Are you telling me to submit to 
providence?
choice_data_list:
If that injury gets worse, you'll be out 
of action even longer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Right, I have an ambition to 
fulfill. Today is not the day to show off 
my brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Know thyself... For now, let us surrender 
to the flow of time.

Tanino Gimlet rested quietly, dedicating 
herself to recovering from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I will agree to that pact. Falling 
here is hardly my intention either.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Onward we go! Beyond this path lies the 
realization of my will!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The me within tells myself. Now is not yet 
the time to display that fleeting 
brilliance...

With his injury worsening, Tanino Gimlet 
gave up on training and devoted himself to 
treatment...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Hahahahaha! Just as I thought! You 
must never banish the hero from your 
soul!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
By overcoming this great wall, I shall 
seize a new passion in my grasp!!

Tanino Gimlet trained within reasonable 
limits and made a smooth return to form!
